steps.title: Pick the right land
steps.say: Villages are in [plains](biome:plains), [deserts](biome:desert), [savannas](biome:savanna), [taigas](biome:taiga), [meadows](biome:meadow) and [snowy plains](biome:snowy_plains). Start your search there.

steps.title: Look from up high
steps.say: Climb a hill or a tall tree and look around. Villages have roofs, paths and fields you can see from far away.

steps.title: Follow a path
steps.say: [Dirt](item:dirt) paths [lead](item:lead) into villages. If you find one, follow it.

steps.title: Find the middle
steps.say: The [bell](item:bell) sits in the middle of the village, where villagers meet during the day.

steps.title: Be kind
steps.say: Do not hit villagers. The [iron golem](mob:iron_golem) protects them and fights back.

steps.title: Remember the way
steps.say: Write down the coordinates, or build a tall tower of blocks with a [torch](item:torch) on top. Then you can find it again.
